expected: label=drivable_area includes the visible paved roadway continuing behind the temporarily occluding taxi/bus; no polygon on the vehicles
rationale: The downstream free-space module needs the road surface while vehicle detection handles the temporary obstacles separately.

expected: geometry: polygon follows the visible roadway boundaries and continues behind the temporarily occluding taxi/bus only where the road direction and boundaries support it
rationale: Stopping at every vehicle would fragment the road surface supplied to free-space estimation.

expected: IGNORE: do not include the taxi/bus bodies or sidewalk in drivable_area
rationale: Including vehicles or sidewalk as free space can misstate the safe area available to obstacle avoidance.

expected: IGNORE: no drivable_area polygon over the yellow hatched turn-lane/keep-clear region; label the adjacent legal traffic lanes
rationale: The contract excludes hatched keep-clear pavement; treating it as drivable may direct the planner into a prohibited or unsafe area.

expected: geometry: polygon boundary follows the visible edge of the yellow hatching and does not cross into the hatched region
rationale: A boundary that crosses the hatching overstates the free space available to the planner.

expected: label=drivable_area covers the visible legal paved lanes on both sides of the hatched region
rationale: The annotation must preserve usable roadway without merging the excluded central area into it.

expected: IGNORE: do not draw drivable_area over the triangular traffic island; label the surrounding visible roadway
rationale: The traffic island is explicitly outside the drivable scope even though it is adjacent to pavement.

expected: geometry: polygon boundary follows the visible edge of the traffic island and leaves the island outside drivable_area; set needs_review=true only if that edge is genuinely indeterminate
rationale: A misplaced boundary can count a fixed obstacle as free space and distort the drivable region.

expected: IGNORE: exclude the snowbank piled into the traffic lane from drivable_area
rationale: The downstream planner must not treat the obstructing snowbank as safe traversable space.

expected: geometry: polygon stops at the visible outer edge of the snowbank and does not extend across the piled snow
rationale: Extending the polygon over the snowbank overestimates safe free space and may route the vehicle into an obstruction.
